items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Frankie and I would work -- we worked some dancing school things together.

ctx.x: I did this particular date with Frankie. That's another record -- I think I had record of that (inaudible) -- I think I heard that album because I would love Frankie.
Frankie and I would work -- we worked some dancing school things together. Frankie was out that age too.
Rudy Powell was in the band with me and June Clark down on 14th Street. That was the alto player -- Rudy Powell.
